trade_signal_doctrine.entry_logic: Preemptive entry at predicted wick-rejection zone (defensive staff) with tight SL; no waiting for confirmation.
confluences: Confluence 1: ICT/SMC Liquidity Sweep of HTF lows (76464, 76563) down to 76046.58 followed by strong displacement and Break of Structure (BOS) on M5/M15. This displacement created a massive bullish pin bar on the H1/H4 timeframes, shifting the short-term trend to bullish and aligning with the H1/M15/M5 trend indicators.

Confluence 2: Fair Value Gap (FVG) alignment with Malaysian SNR (MSNR) and Quarter Theory (QT). The rapid displacement created an unmitigated M15 FVG between 77417.15 and 77566.3, which overlaps with the Major Quarter level of 77500 and a key MSNR Resistance-turned-Support (RBS) level. High ATR (340.72) indicates strong volatility, supporting a quick, sharp retest of this defensive staff zone before continuation.

Confluence 3: Fibonacci Retracement, Supply and Demand, and Candle Range Theory (CRT) alignment. The defensive staff zone at 77415 - 77550 aligns with the 0.382 Fibonacci retracement level (77345.71) of the expansion leg (76046.58 to 78148.74). This zone represents a newly formed M15 demand zone. According to CRT, the price is retracing to the discount portion of the current session's range, while the RSI at 66.2 confirms strong bullish momentum is preserved during this shallow pullback.

Confluence 4: Trendline Break & Bounce, Chart Patterns (Double Bottom/Liquidity Sweep), and ICT/SMC Mitigation. The liquidity sweep at 76046.58 formed a highly reactive double bottom/sweep pattern on the HTF, breaking the descending trendline that has capped price since 80341. The subsequent pullback to 77485.00 serves as a preemptive mitigation of the breakout point, supported by the massive volume signature of the initial rejection.

Confluence 5: Quarter Theory (QT), Malaysian SNR (MSNR), and Supply and Demand. The 77500 Major Quarter level acts as a psychological and structural anchor, reinforced by the MSNR RBS level and the M15 demand zone. This confluence of structural support is expected to hold as a defensive staff, aligning with the rising EMA50/200 on lower timeframes to propel price toward the HTF liquidity targets.

confidence_model.dominant_bias_reason: The massive liquidity sweep of HTF lows at 76046.58 followed by strong bullish displacement, M5/M15 BOS, and the creation of an unmitigated M15 FVG at 77417.15 - 77566.3 provides an extremely high-probability buy setup. The H4 bearish trend is overridden by the HTF liquidity sweep and the strong bullish momentum on H1/M15/M5.

risk_profile.note: Preemptive entry captures full HTF continuation without waiting for wick confirmation.
